title: Template-Based Text-to-Image Alignment for Language Accessibility: A Study on Visualizing Text Simplifications

bias_targets.methodology: Expert human annotation of VLM-generated images to assess cognitive accessibility for individuals with intellectual disabilities, utilizing scoring dimensions such as Image Simplicity, Text-Image Alignment, and a specific checklist to flag images that are too complex or exclusionary.

Expert evaluation using an 'Ethics' scoring dimension (0-20) and a targeted checklist to identify visual stereotypes, cultural insensitivity, and discriminatory content based on race, gender, and ability in the generated images.
